tagline: A premier real estate investment trust focused on the development, acquisition and management of premier office and life science properties in the United States.
hero_kpi_rationale: Kilroy Realty Corporation is a REIT focused on office and life science real estate. Square footage leased through new contracts and renewals is the key indicator of its ability to generate demand and rental income, a direct reflection of operational performance and the attractiveness of its property portfolio in strategic markets.

kpis.name: Revenu segment IA / cloud
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated by properties located in strategic markets that could benefit from growing demand for AI infrastructure.
kpis.description: Although KRC is a real estate REIT, its properties are located in key technology markets, which could enable it to capture part of the real estate demand related to high-performance computing and cloud infrastructure.
kpis.signal: Growth potential linked to the technology ecosystem.

kpis.name: Marge brute
kpis.explanation: Difference between revenue and cost of goods sold, indicating profitability of core operations.
kpis.description: Gross margin is not a relevant metric for a REIT, which generates rental income rather than product sales.

kpis.name: Marge opérationnelle
kpis.explanation: Operating income divided by revenue, reflecting profitability before interest and taxes.
kpis.description: Operating margin provides insight into company performance before considering capital structure and tax implications.
kpis.signal: Measures the ability to generate profits from core activities.

kpis.name: Investissements R&D (% revenu)
kpis.explanation: Percentage of revenue allocated to research and development activities.
kpis.description: R&D expenditures are not relevant for a real estate REIT that does not develop technology products.

kpis.name: Capital expenditures (CAPEX)
kpis.explanation: Spending dedicated to the acquisition or improvement of long-term physical assets.
kpis.description: CAPEX indicates investments made to maintain or expand operations, particularly in real estate infrastructure for KRC.

kpis.name: Effectif (employés)
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees working for the company.
kpis.description: Headcount is an indicator of operational capacity and personnel costs.
kpis.signal: Indicator of organizational size and growth.

kpis.name: Dette totale
kpis.explanation: Total amount of long-term and short-term financial obligations of the company.
kpis.description: Total debt represents the company's borrowed financing, a key factor in analyzing its financial structure. As of December 31, 2025, KRC had total debt of $4.6 billion (before debt discounts and deferred financing costs).
kpis.signal: Indicates leverage level and financial risk.

kpis.name: Variable interest rate debt portion
kpis.explanation: Percentage of total debt subject to variable interest rates.
kpis.description: This measure indicates the company's sensitivity to changes in market interest rates. As of December 31, 2025, 4.3% of KRC's total debt was subject to variable rates, with the remainder at fixed rates.

kpis.name: Leased square footage (new and renewed)
kpis.explanation: Total volume of square feet leased through new contracts or renewals.
kpis.description: This KPI measures the attractiveness of KRC's real estate portfolio and its ability to maintain high occupancy rates. In 2025, KRC executed new and renewal leases totaling 1.8 million square feet, excluding short-term leases.
kpis.signal: Key indicator of leasing activity and demand for properties.

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Montant total versé en dividendes par action sur l'année fiscale.

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Total annuel : dividendes versés + rachats d'actions.
kpis.description: Cumulative dividends + buybacks (2021-2025) in billions USD. Source yfinance cashflow.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Part du résultat net redistribuée. >80 % = potentiellement non soutenable.

risks.title: Decline in rental rates
risks.score_rationale: The company recorded a 9.3% decrease in rental revenue and an 18.4% decrease in contractual rental rates for second-generation leases.

risks.title: Lease non-renewal risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to lease non-renewal risk, which could result in revenue loss.

risks.title: Regional economic dependence
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to regional economic conditions, which could impact its operations.

risks.title: Development and repositioning risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to risks related to property development and repositioning, which could lead to additional costs and delays.

risks.title: Financing risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to financing risks, which could result in additional costs and difficulties funding its operations.

risks.title: Competition risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to competition, which could lead to market share and revenue loss.

risks.title: Regulatory risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to regulatory risks, which could result in additional costs and challenges in complying with regulatory requirements.

ai_positioning.summary: The company KRC has no significant mentions regarding artificial intelligence, machine learning, or similar technologies in the provided excerpts from its 10-K/20-F filing.
